_readme: Claude Code wire values that both the Go provider and the TypeScript plugin use. Anthropic owns them. modes are the permission modes: the worker sends them in set_permission_mode, and the browser plugin builds its permission presets and its plan-mode toggle from the same strings. defaultMode is the mode a Claude session with no stored one falls back to; the mode a NEW session requests is Auto, and the PermissionDefaults of the Claude registration (Registration in backend/internal/worker/agent/providers/claude/registration.go) is that fact's one home. systemSubtypes are the subtypes of a system line that state an API retry or a compaction boundary: the worker classifies each one as a notification, and the browser plugin draws it. The status subtype is not in this table, because the shared isFinalCompactingStatus in frontend/src/components/chat/messageUtils.ts reads that shape for the Claude, Codex and ACP plugins.
